svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills whose purple clock says free until 15:00, then names the next meeting: Standup in 27m. A click opens the Timetable drawer out of the clock: Chicago, EET and GMT side by side, Standup next with Join on workspace 2 and Copy link, the day strip with every hour ruled, its events, dashed free gaps that say how long they are and a red now line tagged 14:33, the rest of today under it, and a focus block sized to the gap before Standup. The arrow beside the day steps to tomorrow, with an all-day release freeze, an unanswered invite outlined and a maybe striped, and Today comes back. Starting the focus block turns the clock green, counting down from 25:00, and tints its gap on the strip; pointing at Standup outlines it, and its tooltip says a click opens it in Google Calendar. Later the clock goes amber at Standup in 2m, then red with Standup · Join at 15:00, and a middle-click switches to the meeting on workspace 2, where the clock counts the joined meeting down calmly: Standup · 15m left.
